purpose: Record the P22-12 help family physical split completion and the P22-13 doctor preflight refresh while keeping doctor files in the shared command package.
policy: This evidence does not authorize a broad command package split. The help family is already moved, and P22-13 refreshes the doctor preflight only; doctor, shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, and output helpers remain in the command package until a dedicated P22-14 doctor split.
preflightContracts: help remains reachable through root help dispatch and command-specific help routing
help output stays stdout-only through the command output adapter
doctor remains reachable through root command dispatch
doctor --json stays stdout-only with stable nextActions fields
bug --json supportBundle remains available for doctor remediation guidance
only help files moved into the help subpackage; doctor and shared files remain in the command package

physicalSplitAdmission.nextAllowedAction: In P22-14, move only the doctor family after preserving diagnostics, support bundle JSON, stdout/stderr behavior, help routing, and command registration.
physicalSplitAdmission.blockedAction: Do not move shared helpers, root wiring, JSON helpers, output helpers, help adapter, or bug support bundle code in the doctor split commit.
physicalSplitAdmission.rollbackRequirement: Restore all help files to cmd/gofly/internal/command in one commit if help output, topic routing, docs-check, command registration, stdout, or stderr behavior changes.
